'''2008 Worlds Team Michael Raveling DS Agents Of Black Sun''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Michael Raveling]] at [[2008 World Championship]] (Team Tournament). Sheet title MARY Tyler MOORE. LIGHT SIDE checkbox marked in error; list is Dark Side Agents Of Black Sun.


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Michael Raveling]]
* '''Event:''' [[2008 World Championship]]
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS16]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' [[Agents Of Black Sun / Vengeance Of The Dark Prince|Agents Of Black Sun]]
* '''Stage:''' Team Tournament
